blocks.text: Affordable. Clean. Reliable. The perfect Ice Castle sleeper for small groups and families looking for a cozy night on Detroit Lake.

The 17' Trophy Hunter is our most affordable sleeper house — ideal for families and small groups who want a comfortable, clean, and warm Ice Castle experience without overcomplicating things. It’s a great fit for budget-minded groups who still want the premium Baxstar Fishing service, great location, drilled holes, and full setup waiting for them when they arrive. 


 


If you want a simple, cozy house with everything you need for a fun night on the ice, the Trophy is your go-to.​

The Trophy Hunter includes:



 
 Bottom bunk: 48" wide (1-2 people)

 

 
 Top bunk: 44" wide

 

 
 Front bunks: Two 30" bunks

 

 
 Sleeps: Up 4-5 people total

 



This is a warm and functional setup that keeps everyone comfortable without sacrificing floor space for fishing.

Forced-air furnace for reliable, all-night heat

 

 
 Included 2500w generator

 

 
 Blankets and pillows included

 

 
 Multiple lighting option

 

 
 CO₂ and smoke detectors

 



These features keep the house safe, warm, and dependable during overnight stays — even on the coldest winter nights.

Bucket and toilet seat set up

 

 
 Garbage bag liners required

 

 
 Private bathroom enclosure

 

 
 Ventilation for comfort

 

 
 Easy and clean waste removal

Turn key ready

 

 
 Pre-drilled holes

 

 
 Easy parking near the house

 

 
 Close access to Detroit Lakes dining and stores

 

 
 Guide support available if needed
